dedupe_keys.name: european catchments and rivers network system ecrins lakes and reservoirs version 1 jun 2012

description: European catchments and Rivers network system (Ecrins), lakes and reservoirs - version 1, Jun. 2012 is a dataset listed in EEA SDI - geospatial data catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by sdi.eea.europa.eu. This dataset contains the “lakes” datasets of Ecrins v1.0. Lakes are very important features of any hydrographical system and have hence been added to Ecrins. This feature is more uncertain than the other ones since it results from the processing of different sources under a twin constraint of relevance and free of charges accessibility. Coverage: Europe. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-eea-sdi.
